ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast bimodal distribution; dominant high-intensity white regions on the lateral lobes with a low-intensity black central region and dense linear markings.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white pixel fields across both lobes; central low-intensity black region surrounding the peduncle junction; widespread dark linear streaks and irregular clusters distributed across the white surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible V-shaped median notch with a wide obtuse angle; significant depth relative to the horizontal fluke axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude irregular serrations (jagged peaks) along the entire trailing edge boundary, isolated from the background water.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the inner trailing edge transition; convex sweep along the outer margins toward tapered lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of small, circular, high-contrast pixel groups (raised texture) concentrated at the distal tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Dense network of dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) crossing the white ventral pigmentation at various angles on both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive linear rake marks across both lobes; highly irregular, jagged trailing edge suggesting previous physical interactions.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced textural irregularities and barnacle-like protrusions visible on the extreme lateral margins.
